title: Triple Trustworthiness Measurement for Knowledge Graph
reasoning: The paper uses examples involving 'Religion' (e.g., BinLaden, Religion, Islam; Obama, Religion, Protestantism) to illustrate its method for evaluating the trustworthiness of triples within a knowledge graph. These are used as data examples within the KG for error detection, not as a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics themselves.
